notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
Spejson once mentioned something about the game coming out this fall… or maybe in winter… but even though winter hasn’t arrived yet, we’ve got good and bad news:  
[list]  
[*] Bad news – it’s not working.  
[*] Good news – we’re almost done!  
[/list]  
We still need some time to polish the new locations, most of which are honestly pretty average.

Wojtas found himself in a hospital. Why? Because he’s fu… well, let’s just say you’ll find out in due time.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972520/d36f7647ac1110b8d5bacfc6135b1c467ad964c1.gif[/img]  

It quickly becomes clear that this isn’t just any facility—it’s a specialized hospital located in ******.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972520/7c5650494d4ae48b98b65f7e714a8e2a637802c6.gif[/img]  

And things get worse—Wojtas isn’t alone. Walo ended up there too, but let’s just say he won’t have the fondest memories of this visit...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972520/7d845adcf95f534b0c24dc6fddb9a7b083e8a2dd.gif[/img]  

And what about the other patients? Let’s just say their intentions are far from peaceful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972520/eb6b4ed314da5936bb6539085bfafe0d823e224d.gif[/img]  

You won’t only encounter our crew there but also a gang of absolute lunatics...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972520/ac117d450b0e73ea92528a737d0dcd2c20a070f3.gif[/img]  

That’s it for today! The location is playable, but we’re still working on the details.
